narr: Widespread showers and thunderstorms brought heavy rain to northern and central New Jersey on the afternoon and evening of July 9. Rainfall totals were as high as 3 to around 5 inches.
ev: Road closures along NJ Route 49 between Interstate 295 and Chestnut Street in Pennsville Township due to flooding.
NJ Route 44 was closed at Berkley Road in Paulsboro due to flooding.
Minor flooding occurred along the Neshanic River in Raritan Township.
Moderate flooding occurred on the Lamington River between Bedminster Township and Branchburg Township.
Halls Mill Road in Readington Township became impassable due to flooding.
The South Branch of the Raritan River overflowed and flooded the Camp Carr Campground in Clinton Township.
lsr: Public sent in video of fast moving water across Halls Mills Road near Pottersville, NJ. Time estimated from radar.
Closed due to flooding inPennsville on Rt 49 EB between I-295/US-40 and Chestnut St.
Clinton Township Police have posted pictures of the Raritan River flooding the Camp Carr campgrounds. Police on scene.
The Raritan River gauge at Stanton reached minor flood stage.
The Neshanic River at Reaville reached minor flood stage.
The Lamington River gauge at Burnt Mills reached minor flood stage.
